title: A Comparison of 4% Articaine Versus 0.5%Bupivacaine for Ambulatory Surgery Under Supraclavicular Block
brief_summary: Effect of 2%Articaine versus 5%bupivacaine in pt undergoing short duration surgery in upper limb
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* upper limb surgery
* ganglion removal
* k wiring
* Carapal tunnel

Exclusion Criteria:

* Coagulopathy.
* infection at site of injection.
* patient refusal.
* hypersensitivity.
